text:
alex: Heads up: p99 latency spike on kv-proxy at ~11:23 UTC, traced to the connpool change. I have a rollback PR ready to unroll the change: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/2591. Can someone give a quick review+approve? Need to merge during this low-traffic window. @maya @devon

maya: on it, looking now

devon: i can eyeball in 2 mins. is there a canary? any risk to state?

alex: It's config-only change (connpool defaults). Canary showed same issue on staging. No stateful changes. Plan: merge -> immediate canary rollout to 5% -> monitor 10m -> full rollout. I've pasted the rollback command in the PR.

sre-bot: INCIDENT: latency spike on kv-proxy detected — p95 420ms -> 550ms. Pagerduty alert created: INC-4821

maya: LGTM for code. a couple minor comment nits but not blockers. approve.

devon: approved. I'll be available in +2 to merge if maya confirms. Can someone grab the dashboards after merge?

alex: thanks — I'll merge and kick canary. merging now...

ci-bot: CI: all checks passed for PR #2591. Deploy pipeline queued.

ci-bot: Deploy: canary rollout started for infra/kv-proxy rev=3b2f7fa -> 5%

maya: watching metrics dashboard https://dash.redwood/internal/dash/kv-proxy — p99 dropping already to ~180ms :thumbsup:

devon: confirming no error spike. good to continue to 100% in 5m?

alex: I'll continue to 100% if no regressions at 5m. tagging @oncall for visibility.

sre-bot: Alert resolved: INC-4821 closed by user alex

maya: Thanks. One follow-up: please open a short postmortem with timeline + PR id so we capture cause.

alex: will draft a 2-paragraph note in #postmortems later today. closing thread.
